[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/KWaN3jU.png[/img][/center]Machine Progression System adds [b]new tiered upgrades to the artisan and refining equipment[/b] in Stardew Valley. These upgrades allow you to [b]improve your machines[/b] in a variety of ways. Through an [b]extensive configuration system [/b]provided by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], you can:
[list]
[*]Fully customize [b]processing times[/b], input and output [b]quantities[/b], and the [b]quality[/b] of the final products.
[*]Choose whether machines should [b]copy the quality[/b] of the input item.
[*]Unlock new, goal-based [b]production bonuses[/b] as you progress.
[*]Access entirely [b]new and exciting features[/b] unique to Machine Progression System.
[*]Create and configure over [b]50 new products[/b], designed to rebalance underused processes and support entirely new playstyles.
[/list]
The Machine Progression System features [b]six upgrade tiers[/b]: [b]Stee[/b]l, [b]Gold[/b], [b]Diamond[/b], [b]Iridium[/b], [b]Radioactive [/b]and [b]Prismatic[/b]. With the Upgrade Packs introduced by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41850015]tlitookilakin[/url]'s incredible [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024][b]Machine Upgrade System[/b][/url], players can [b]upgrade their machines[/b] and unlock all the benefits mentioned above. The Machine Upgrade System also allows for [b]extensive customization[/b] of the upgrade process, giving you full control over the system. You can:
[list]
[*]Choose the [b]amounts of resources needed[/b] to craft an upgrade pack, allowing you to [b]customize the difficulty[/b] to your preference.
[*]Change the [b]resources required[/b] to craft each upgrade, giving you control over the [b]materials you wish to use[/b]. 
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/8WCqEHx.png[/img][/center]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41850015]tlitookilakin[/url]'s amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024][b]Machine Upgrade System[/b][/url], upgrading machines is now easier than ever. Here is how it works:
[list=1]
[*][b]Unlock the base recipe[/b]. Before upgrading a machine, you must unlock its base recipe. For example, you cannot upgrade a Keg until you reach Farming level 8.
[*][b]Craft an Upgrade Pack[/b]. Open your Crafting Menu and craft the appropriate Upgrade Pack. To find out which one you need, simply hover over the machine.
[*][b]Apply the Upgrade Pack[/b]. You can apply the Upgrade Pack [b]d[/b][b]irectly[/b] on the machine placed in the world or while the machine is in your [b]inventory.[/b]
[/list]

[center][size=4][b]Bait Maker[/b]
[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/QGmEKUf.png[/img][/center][spoiler]
[quote][b]Bait Makers[/b] create [b]Targeted Bait[/b] from any fish. This bait will increase the chance to catch that fish when attached to the fishing rod (on top of reducing the delay before a nibble by 50%).[/quote]
[b]3.0 Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Bait Makers can now optionally [b]produce Roe[/b] from the fish that is put in the machine. 
[*]This machine receives an [b]output bonus[/b] if the player has fished 100, 300 and 500 times.
[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The minimum and maximum [b]amount of output[/b] produced.
[*]The [b]chance[/b] for additional [b]Roe[/b] to be produced.
[*]The minimum and maximum [b]amount of Roe[/b] produced.
[*]The [b]output bonus amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Bone Mill[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Lm3Rgy.png[/img][/center][spoiler]
[quote][b]Bone Mills[/b] produce [b]fertilizers[/b] from a bone item (it is to say, those that have a bone_item context tag). Those are: ﻿Bone Flute, Prehistoric Scapula, Prehistoric Tibia, Prehistoric Skull, Skeletal Hand, Prehistoric Rib, Prehistoric Vertebra, Skeletal Tail, Nautilus Fossil, Amphibian Fossil, Palm Fossil, Trilobite, Fossilized Skull, Fossilized Spine, Fossilized Tail, Fossilized Leg, Fossilized Ribs, Fossilized Skull, Snake Skull, Snake Vertebrae, Mummified Bat, Mummified Frog and Bone Fragment.[/quote]
[b]3.0 Features[/b]
[list]
[*]The [b]Diamond Bone Mill[/b] produces a random fertilizer out of: Quality Fertilizer, Speed-Gro, Deluxe Speed-Gro or Tree Fertilizer.
[*]The [b]Iridium, Radioactive and Prismatic Bone Mills[/b] produce a random fertilizer out of: Deluxe Fertilizer, Hyper Speed-Gro, Deluxe Retaining Soil or Tree Fertilizer.
[*]This machine receives an output bonus if the player has killed 100, 300 and 500 Skeletons (it takes Skeletons, Skeleton Mages, Skeleton Warriors and Pepper Rexes into account).
[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure:
[list]
[*]The [b]minutes required[/b] for production.
[*]The minimum and maximum [b]output quantity[/b].
[*]The [b]output bonus[/b] [b]amount[/b].
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=4]Cask[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uEELivz.png[/img][/center][spoiler]
[quote][b]Casks[/b] age products. Aging means [b]increasing a product's quality[/b]. These casks can be [b]placed everywhere[/b]. [/quote]
[b]3.0 Features[/b]
Casks can now age every Artisan Product and a few more items. These items are divided into four groups, depending on their aging speed. 
[list]
[*][b]Group 1[/b] (the slowest): Dried Fruit, Dried Mushrooms, Mineral Water, Wine.
[*][b]Group 2[/b]: Berry Liqueur, Gems, Juice, Meads, Minerals.
[*][b]Group 3[/b]: Aged Roe, Caviar, Gourmet Shellfish, Jelly, Pickles.
[*][b]Group 4[/b] (the fastest): Aged Coffee, Aged Milk, Aged Triple Shot Espresso, Beer, Cheese, Cloth, Coffee, Dishes, Dried Chips, Feather Bundle, Flower Oil, Honey, Ink of the Abyss, Luxury Cloth, Mayonnaise, Oil, Pale Ale, Pu-erh Tea, Raisins, Royal Jelly, Smoked Cheese, Smoked Egg, Smoked Fish, Syrups, Tea, Triple Shot Espresso, Truffle Oil, Vinegar.
[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]
You can configure the [b]speed[/b] at which Casks age each group of items. The higher the aging multiplier, the less time it takes for the product to age.
[/spoiler]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/77BwRa7.png[/img][/center][b]Machine Progression System is compatible with everything[/b], as it does not modify any vanilla assets or those of other mods, and only adds and builds on new content. It is safe to install alongside any mods and at any point in your playthrough. [b]It will never cause any conflicts or errors[/b].

However, I do not know if it works as intended with the [b]Android[/b] version of SMAPI. [center][img]https://i.imgur.com/AyNdsgf.png[/img][/center]If you are a modder and would like your mod to be integrated with Machine Progression System, there are a few things you can do [b]on your end[/b] to make the process easier. Feel free to ask me any questions!

[spoiler]
[b]Bait Maker[/b]
 - The Bait Maker creates Targeted Bait and/or Roe from any item in the category_fish (-4). 

[b]Bee House[/b]
 - The Bee House creates Honey and/or Royal Jelly from any item in the category_flowers (-80).

[b]Bone Mill[/b]
 - The Bone Mill creates Fertilizers from any bone_item. If you want to add items to the pool of Fertilizers, you only need to make a patch that targets the RandomItemId section.

[b]Cask[/b]
 - The Cask ages items in the category_gem (-2), category_cooking (-7), category_minerals (-12), category_syrup (-27).
 - It also ages items with the Context Tags cheese_item, mayo_item and tea_item.
 - If your custom item doesn't belong to any of the categories above and doesn't have any of the context tags mentioned, there are four context tags you can use: cask_group1_item, cask_group2_item, cask_group3_item and cask_group4_item. Group 1 is the one that takes the longest to age (like Wine) and Group 4 is the one that takes the shortest to age (like Cheese). Adding these context tags would automatically make your product ageable in the MPS casks.

[b]Charcoal Kiln[/b]
 - The Charcoal Kiln can burn Furniture, items in the category_furniture (-24).

[b]Cheese Press[/b]
 - The Cheese Press can make Gruyère Cheese from any item with the edible_mushroom context tag.
 - If your mod adds any items to the Cheese Press, it needs a patch on my end (let me know!).

[b]Crab Pot[/b]
 - The Crab Pot catches fish in the category_fish (-4). 

[b]Crystalarium[/b]
 - The Crystalarium can replicate any item in the category_gem (-2), category_minerals (-12) and category_metal_resources (-15).

[b]Dehydrator[/b]
 - The Dehydrator can make Dried Fruit from any item in the category_fruit (-79) and Dried Mushrooms from any item with the edible_mushroom context tag.
 - If your mod adds any items to the Dehydrator, it needs a patch on my end (let me know!).

[b]Fish Smoker[/b]
 - The Fish Smoker smokes any item in the category_fish (-4) or with the cheese_item or egg_item context tags.
 - If your mod adds any items to the Fish Smoker, it needs a patch on my end (let me know!).

[b]Furnaces and Heavy Furnaces[/b]
 - The Furnaces can smelt any item in the category_gem (-2) and category_minerals (-12).
 - If your mod adds any items to the Furnaces, it needs a patch on my end (let me know!).

[b]Geode Crusher[/b]
 - If you want to add new drops for the different Geodes, you only need to make a patch that targets the RandomItemId section.
 - If your mod adds new Geodes or breakable items, it needs a patch on my end (let me know!).

[b]Keg[/b]
 - The Keg can make Juice from any item in the category_vegetable (-75), category_greens (-81) or with the keg_juice context tag. It can also make Wine from any item in the category_fruits (-79) or with the keg_wine context tag. Additionally, you can make Berry Liqueur with any item with the berry_item context tag and Mineral Water with any item in the category_gem (-2) or category_minerals (-12).
 - If your mod adds any items to the Keg, it needs a patch on my end (let me know!).

[b]Loom[/b]
 - The Loom makes Feather Bundles from any item with the feather_item context tag.
 - If your mod adds any items to the Loom, it needs a patch on my end (let me know!).

[b]Mayonnaise Machine[/b]
 - The Mayonnaise Machine makes regular Mayonnaise from any item with the large_egg_item or egg_item context tags. 
 - If your mod adds any items to the Mayonnaise Machine, it needs a patch on my end (let me know!).

[b]Mushroom Log[/b]
 - The Mushroom Log can output items with the tree_syrup_item context tag.

[b]Oil Maker[/b]
 - The Oil Maker makes Flower Oil from any item in the category_flowers (-80).
 - If your mod adds any items to the Oil Maker, it needs a patch on my end (let me know!).

[b]Preserves Jar[/b]
 - The Preserves Jar makes Pickles from any item in the category_vegetable (-75), category_greens (-81) or with the preserves_pickle context tag. It can also make Jelly from any item in the category_fruits (-79) or with the preserves_Jelly context tag. Additionally, you can make Aged Milk with any items with the milk_item or large_milk_item context tags and Gourmet Shellfish from any items with the fish_crab_pot context tags.
 - If your mod adds any items to the Preserves Jar, it needs a patch on my end (let me know!).

[b]Recycling Machine[/b]
 - If you want to add new drops to the recycled Trash (item 168), you only need to make a patch that targets the RandomItemId section.

[b]Seed Maker[/b]
 - The Seed Maker makes seeds from any crop and Mixed Seeds from any item with the category_greens (-81).
 - If your mod adds Fruit Trees, it needs a patch on my end (let me know!).

[b]Slime Egg-Press[/b]
 - If you want to add new drops to the press, you only need to make a patch that targets the RandomItemId section.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/IVBEHgW.png[/img][/center][quote]﻿Can you [b]integrate[/b] 'x' mod with Machine Progression System?[/quote]
[b]Of course[/b]! I am always happy to integrate Machine Progression System with new mods and ensure continued compatibility. Feel free to leave a comment with a link to the mod, and I will do my best to update it as soon as possible.

[quote]﻿Can you create new upgrades for [b]machines added by other mods[/b]?[/quote]
[b]No[/b]. Machine Progression System only adds upgrades for the artisan and refining machines that are part of the base game. However, mod authors are welcome to create their own machine upgrades in line with MPS' philosophy.

[quote]Why does the Loom have a [b]machine for every tier[/b], while the Oil Maker only starts at Diamond?[/quote]
The Loom recipe does not require any of the materials used in the progression system—Iron Bars, Gold Bars, Diamonds, Iridium Bars, Radioactive Bars, or Prismatic Shards. On the other hand, the Oil Maker requires a Gold Bar, so it starts at the Diamond tier and skips the first two. I probably could have given every machine all seven tiers, but this approach made the most sense to me when I first designed MPS.
